mapper.select: SELECT tc.id AS itemId, tc.content_id AS contentId, c.title, c.content_type AS contentType, c.cover_url AS coverUrl, c.summary, c.category_id AS categoryId, c.status, tc.sort FROM topic_content tc INNER JOIN content c ON c.id = tc.content_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE tc.topic_id = #{topicId} AND tc.deleted = 0 ORDER BY tc.sort ASC, tc.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT tc.id AS itemId, tc.content_id AS contentId, c.title, c.content_type AS contentType, c.cover_url AS coverUrl, c.summary, c.category_id AS categoryId, c.status, c.publish_time AS publishTime, tc.sort FROM topic_content tc INNER JOIN content c ON c.id = tc.content_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE tc.topic_id = #{topicId} AND tc.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND c.content_type IN ('ARTICLE', 'VIDEO', 'QUESTION', 'WEEKLY', 'DOCUMENT') ORDER BY tc.sort ASC, tc.id ASC
SELECT MAX(tc.sort) FROM topic_content tc WHERE tc.topic_id = #{topicId} AND tc.deleted = 0
